name: @red-cup-engineering/package-installation-check-service
description: Installs packages from an npm registry into a clean temporary directory and checks that everything they ship actually resolves and runs. Use when verifying that published packages really install and import cleanly.

scripts.verify: node --check src/check-package-installation.mjs && node --check scripts/check-package-installation.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs && npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
